name: tool-fold
description: Each tool call as one quiet line, its result folded away (click to unfold); /tools panel lists every call beside the chat, each in a view that suits its tool (MongoDB in Compass style). /tools toggles it.

yieldExpanded.title: Leave expanded views to the engine
yieldExpanded.description: Draw tool calls the engine's way where it shows them in full: the ctrl+o transcript and verbose mode. Off folds them there too.
